recipes.label: Execute a reconnaissance mission?
recipes.startdescription: [The mission will not be intercepted. Upon success, it grants an intelligence bonus to all friendly forces. Only one such mission can be active at a time.]

recipes.label: Execute a bombing mission?
recipes.startdescription: [The mission may be intercepted. Upon success, it weakens the enemy and cuts off their supplies. Up to three such missions can be active simultaneously.]

recipes.label: Our forces launch aerial combat!
recipes.startdescription:
Victory and defeat hinge on a single moment.

[In aerial combat, the attacker can only use fighters; the defender can additionally use bombers and anti-aircraft emplacements. However, if the defender wins, air superiority returns to neutral. If both sides have forces present, there is a chance that aircraft may run out of fuel and become exhausted, or be shot down and damaged.]
